Fresh Oysters with Green Mangoes
Kinilaw Na Talaba - Fresh Oysters with Green Mangoes, The day's catch of oysters, from waters noted for the chociest seafoods. Blanched and served with shredded green mangoes. A true delicacy.
Fresh Tuna in Vinegar
Nilagpang Na Bantalaan- Fresh Tuna in Vinegar, Have a taste of deep sea adventure with a serving of yellow fin tuna sliced thinly and marinated in spices.
Lumpiang Ubod - Palm Egg Roll, A coconut tree gives up its life for this aristocrat of an egg roll which contains its heart of palm
Palm Egg Roll
Sliced Ham in Honey
Hamonado Aurora - Sliced Ham in Honey, From the gourmets of Aurora town in Quezon province, ham slices boiled in honey syrup and touched with the fragrance of pandan (wild grass) leaves.
Chicken Sultana
Manok Sultana - Chicken Sultana, Straight out of a colorful Zamboanga feast. Sliced breast of chicken with an exotic sauce of carabao cheese and milk blended with spices.
Tinilmok Na Hipon - Shrimps with Coconut-Meat in Banana Leaves, An irresitible cold Bicolano treat of fresh shrimps and young coconut meat wrapped in banana leaves.
Shrimps with Coconut-Meat in Banana Leaves
Sapayan Sa Mangga - Prawns with Mango, Boiled king prawns, marinated in rhum and kalamansi (native lemon) juice, and served on a slice of mango- the way it was prepared for the early chieftans of the queen city of Cebu centuries ago.
Prawns with Mango
Fried Egg Roll
Pritong Lumpia - Fried Egg Roll, the most familiar local version of the traditional Chinese egg roll. Vegetables take center stage for this famous dish.
Kuhol Sa Gata - Ricefield Snails in Cocomilk, During the rains, the ricefield yeilds a popular delicacy- delicious snails, cooked best with coconut milk.
Ricefield Snails in Cocomilk
Hipon Sa Ladda -- Sauted Spicy Shrimps, To tickle the palate, Bicolanos depart from the usual, and saute the shrimps in tomatoes and green and red pepper.
Sauted Spicy Shrimps
Stuffed Shrimps
Relyenong Hipon - Stuffed Shrimps, From Chinatown's noted kitchens come this party favorite- shrimps stuffed with ground pork and shrimp-meat
Fried Chicken Wings
Pritong Pakpak Ng Manok - Fried Chicken Wings, Cosmopolitan Manila's current fancy- boneless chicken wings marinated in spicy sauce and fried crisp.
Pusit Espesyal- Squids Speciale, A mouth-watering plate of baby squid deep-fried in corn oil, with garlic and pepper, served steaming hot.
Squids Speciale
Cured Venison
Tapang Usa - Cured Venison, The ultimate hunter's prize - venison strips cured with brown sugar, salt, and spices.
Sinigang, Sinigang is the one Filipino soup that has stood the test of taste and time. The all-weather brew of choice meat or fish, a mix of garden vegetables, and some garnish to make it sour and tangy.
Sugpo Sinigang - King prawns soured with the kamias fruit.
Kanduli Sinigang - A tasty fresh-water fish with miso (bean curd) and fresh mustard leaves.
Hipon Sinigang - Shrimps with kamias.
Lapu-lapu Sinigang - The favorite fish for feasts, flavored with tamarind.
Baboy Sinigang- Chunks of pork with gabi (yam) and the tamarind.
Baka Sinigang- Chunks of beef with gabi (yam) and the tamarind.
Binakol - Chicken with Coconut Milk, An all-time favorite from the feast-loving Honggos- chicken meat in a tasty broth with shredded young coconut meat and tanlad (lemon grass).
Chicken with Coconut Milk soup
Chicken in Tamarind soup
Sinampalukang Manok- Chicken in Tamarind, Another appetizing, tangy soup. Chicken with tender tamarind leaves, cooked in an earthen pot.
Mussel or Clam Soup
Sinuwam Na Tahong O Halaan - Mussel or Clam Soup, Succulent clams sauted and cooked in a clear broth with malunggay or sili (native pepper) leaves.
Pork Dumpling Soup
Pansit Molo - Pork Dumpling Soup, From Iloilo down South comes this special preparation of pork dumplings in a clear soup spiked with garlic.
Pucherong Baka - Beef Puchero, A rich stew of beef, cabbbage, potatoes, garbanzos and saging na saba (a variety of banana).
Beef Puchero soup
Beef consomme
Kaldorosa - Beef Consomme, A hearty soup from the cattle region- consomme of beef, rich in bone marrow and prepared with sago (rice pearls) and spices.
Halabos Na Banagan - Steamed Lobster, Steamed lobster fresh from the sea- representative of indigenous Visayan cooking.
Steamed Lobster
Prawns in Cocomilk
Adobong Sugpo Sa Gata - Prawns in Cocomilk, Seafood and coconuts make and exquisit mix. Specially king prawns in coconut milk spiced with fresh peppercorns.
Hipon Sa Dahon Ng Saging - Steamed Shrimps, Silver-grey shrimps wrapped in banana leaves and steamed to juicy pinkness
Steamed Shrimps
Grouper in Sauce
Sarsiadong Lapu-Lapu - Grouper in Sauce, A dish of lapu-lapu (red grouper) simmered in a sauce of fresh tomatoes, beaten egg, and the special flavor of wild lemon.
Inasal Na Tanguingue - Grilled Mackere, The sought-after Palawan mackerel, skewered and grilled. A real treat.
Grilled Mackerel

Reception- Soleil Blanc - 1964 - Joseph Drouhin (SO-lay Blahn)- A dry white burgundy made from the  shy-bearing Pinot Chardonnay grape.  A well balanced blend of vintage wines of an exceptional year. Try it "nature" and with a drop or two of Cassis Cartron, a black currant Burgundian specialty.
Fish- Chablis Grand Cru Moutonne, 1964 - Estate Bottled - Long Depaqui (Sha-BLEE Grahn Kroo Moo-TOHN)- Pale gold in colour, clean on the palate and free from sweetness or acidity. This six acre vineyard is located at the center point of the hillside north of the village containing all eight of the vineyards designated as Chablis Grand Cru.
Entree- Chateau Rauzan-Segla, Bottled at the Chateau (SHA-toe Roe-zahn-Say-glah)- A distinguished balanced red bordeaux with a lovely ruby colour, velvety body and a faint overtone of wild violets in its bouquet. This carefully tended vineyard is located in the commune of Margaux, and is generally second only to Chateau Margaux itself.
Beef and Cheese- Bonnes-Mares - 1959 - En Magnums, Estate Bottled - Comte Georges de Vogue (Bon-MAHR)- This great red burgundy is a Tete de Cuvee lying partly in Morey St. Denis and partly in Chambolle-Musigny and shares with Musigny the top ranking in this area of great vineyards. The 1959 vintage has matured into expected greatness and you will find further devlopment of aroma and palate as it rests for ten or fifteen minutes in your glass.
Dessert- Gewurztraminer Hugel 1961, Reserve Exceptionnelle Beerenauslese (Geh-VURTZ-trah-mee-ner Hyou-gel) - This rare and highly prized dessert wine is only available once or twice in a decade. When favoured by a long, sunny autumn, the spicy grapes are left on the vines and are picked one by one as they become overripe. The supply is very limited and its production is obviously for prestige, -not profit. For this special experience, we are indebted to the generousity of our Echanson, Kenneth Granger, who presented a case from his cellar.

Broasted Chicken Ala Skillet
(a) FIRST you take a chicken - a tender fresh young fryer grown locally.
(h) Place in refrigerator for at least 4 hours to allow marination to "set".
(b) Cut it in 8 pieces and scrub it clean.
(i) Cook in a pressure vessel developing at least 35 lbs. of pressure.  This, of course, means using a Broaster since it is the only unit utilizing such high pressure.  (It is the high pressure that retains the juices in lieu of a thick batter)
(c) Punch dozens of tiny holes in each piece.  Careful you do not pierce the bone!
(d) Place the chicken in a wire basket and submerge it in a tank of especially-blended marinating fluid.  A hydrometer is necessary to assure even consistancy of seasoning batch after batch.
(j) Use a top-quality vegetable shortening to disperse the heat evenly around the chicken and to brown the flour.
(k) Remove from Broaster after 7 minutes of cooking at 380F.  Cook each order as needed, it only takes 7 minutes.  No problem, - particularly if you have 6 Broasters with a total capacity of 156 pcs. every 7 minutes, like The Skillet has!
(e) Put the tank, marination, and chicken into a vacuum chamber.  Close the lid, and run the vacuum pressure up to 25 lbs.
(f) Release the vacuum, and voila! - the flavoring has penetrated the chicken to the bone.

Bird Nest: Juicy shrimp, scallops and slices of chicken gently sauteed with broccoli and baby corn in garlic sauce, nestled in a crisp basket.
JING-DU PORK STEAK: Tender slices of pork steak marinated and seared in our chef's most sophisticated sauce nestled over onions, garnish with tomato slices and parsley
WESTLAKE FISH: Fresh whole fish delicately prepared in a bamboo steamer, and showered with a scallion and ginger sauce.
GEN-JEN SHRIMP: Jumbo shrimps skillfully sauteed to bring out the natural flavors enhanced with a touch of oyster sauce and harmonized with broccoli.
TRIPLE CROWN: A selection of beef, shrimp and sliced chicken sauteed in a delicate brown sauce, combined with mixed vegetables served on a sizzling platter.
*LOBSTER DELIGHT: Steamed whole 1 1/2-lb lobster, sauce on the side. Spicy Ginger Chili Sauce or Black Bean or Lobster Sauce.
CRYSTAL JUMBO SHRIMP: Whole jumbo shrimp lightly cooked in a wine sauce.
*HUNAM TWO DELICACIES: Fresh scallops and juicy shrimps dipped in lotus flour and stir fried in a special sauce flavored with ginger scallions; harmonizing with broccoli.
*ORANGE BEEF: Slices of prime beef seared to retain the natural flavor, then sauteed over a high flame with orange rind and spicy peppers. A supremely fragrant dish.
*SPICY CRISPY WHOLE FISH: Whole tender fish crisply seared perfect blend of ginger, garlic and chiliwine sauce; An extraordinary dish.
SUPREME DUCK: An expuisite dish prepared similar to Peking Duck - need we say more? Served with delicate plum sauce.
SIZZLING ROYALE: Slices of filet mignon served at your table on a sizzling platter, with fresh mushrooms and snow pea pods. blended with touch of sauce and scallions. It is a feast for both eyes and palate.
BEAN CURD POTAGE: A light dish for every season. Bean curd, black mushrooms, baby shrimp, slices of chicken and rich chicken broth simmered in a casserole, its own natural flavors.
SHA CHIA JUMBO SHRIMP: Sha chia is an ancient oriental sauce, made from a blend of peanut oil, green onion, coriander seed, garlic, hot peppers, Szechuan peppercorns and dried shrimp. Juicy shrimp is then seard for natural tender and flavored with Sha chi
*SESAME CHICKEN: Chunks of chicken gently prepared to create a crispy but tender texture which is sauteed with spicy chili wine sauce. And sprinkled with sesame seeds.
VEGETABLE GARDEN DELIGHT: Naturally seasoned; fresh broccoli, snow pea pods, tomatoes, string beans, baby corn and many exotic vegetables served in a bamboo steamer, for your kind of diet.
GOLDEN SESAME BEEF: Tender slices of beef marinated in fresh egg whites quickly seared to preserve its natural flavor. They are then sauteed in a spicy sauce and crowned with scallioin pancakes.
NEPTUNE'S PLATTER: An assortment of culinary sea treasures; Scallops, lobster, crabmeat, shrimp, fillet of fish; together with crisp rice and Chinese vegetables.
